title: The Curse of the Hollow Trees
causes: A devastating ecological collapse of the southern rainforests
The complete abandonment of hives by the forest bees
outcomes: Jambanson's quest upriver to find the Saraswati Spiceroot
The establishment of an alliance with the western coast Tupi seers
Jambanson's vision at the volcanic Crystal Spire
summary: During a cataclysmic ecological collapse in the Godavari rainforests, the Vanara mystic Jambanson sets off on an epic upriver quest to find the Saraswati Spiceroot, gathering dreamspace knowledge and a sacred moon-seed to save his homeland.
sources: The Mythic Legacy and Ritual Order of Jambenson

title: The Turning of Kunti Against the Seedbearer
causes: Shukradeva and Daedrasura's hold over Kunti, who has no agency of her own
Jambanson's memory-seed work spreading faster than the Asuras could unmake it
outcomes: Kunti is set against the Seedbearer of the South and made to unpick his restorative work
The conflict is remembered as the tricked goddess's, though none of it was her doing
summary: Weaponised by the Asura guru Shukradeva and by Daedrasura, the celestial nymph Kunti is turned against Jambanson and made to disrupt his ecological and ancestral memory-seed magic. She is the instrument and not the author of it, which is the whole of her tragedy: the Land of Myst remembers her as the tricked goddess.

title: The Planting of the Moon-Seed
causes: The gift of the sacred moon-seed from the primordial Narmada Man at the Crystal Spire
outcomes: The rapid, brilliant blooming of the massive Bhuta-Kāna Tree
The healing of the Godavari rainforest's ecological blight
The creation of a living, mycelial archive of ancestral memory
summary: Upon returning to the Godavari rainforests, Jambanson plants the sacred moon-seed received from the Narmada Man. The seed rapidly blossoms into the silver-glowing Bhuta-Kāna Tree, restoring the ecosystem.
sources: Roots and Whispers: The Legacy of the Bhuta-Kāna Tree

title: The Establishment of the Womb Rites
causes: The birth of Jharwa fetuses tainted with dark Asura blood
Jambanson's mastery over protective botanical and acoustic rites
outcomes: The creation of the Jharwa womb-purification exorcisms
The rise of an exclusive, male-led priestly order wielding stone yonis and secret hymns
summary: To protect early human lineages from Asura corruption, Jambanson designs a highly ritualized, male-led womb purification exorcism using sacred resins, stone yonis, and acoustic hymns to purge demonic influence.
sources: The Mythic Legacy and Ritual Order of Jambenson

title: The First Move of the Chess of Fate
causes: Indra's strike with his copper-lotus spear to shatter the continuous frozen sheet of the earth and release subterranean riverbeds
Varuṇa's counter-flooding of the tectonic rifts with lightning-charged, sub-zero waters to protect cosmic Ṛta
outcomes: The official opening of the Tethys Sea and the division of the landmass into the isolated continent of Jambhudweepa
The intervention of Dyauṣ Pitar to bound their raw, chaotic forces into the rules of the sixty-four coordinate board
summary: Indra strikes the first tectonic blow to fracture Gondwana, which Varuṇa quickly floods with the abyssal Tethys waters. This first clash is bounded by Dyauṣ Pitar into the sixty-four coordinate game board.
sources: Vedic Mythology and Version Controlled Tectonic Drift
Compendium of Celestial Beings and Primordial Entities

title: The Fang vs. Scale Wars
causes: ecological_competition
gondwana_tectonic_migration
outcomes: synapsid_diapsid_niche_split
mammalian_reptilian_territories_set
summary: A deep-time evolutionary conflict on Gondwana: ancestral synapsids, the Fang, against emerging diapsid archosaurs, the Scale, for ecological dominance. The gorgonopsids held the fern forests; the archosaurs took the volcanic highlands and the marshy deltas.

title: The Domestication of the Fang Vanguard
causes: The collapse of advanced synapsids following the Permian-Triassic extinction event
The Asura need for resilient pack animals and war cavalry capable of carrying heavy armaments
outcomes: The selective breeding and genetic corruption of surviving Permian cynodonts and gorgonopsids
The introduction of 'Fang' draft animals through the Dwarka Gate, intensifying the war against native diapsids
summary: Fascinated by the ancestral metabolic traits of surviving synapsids, Commander Vaishura selectively breeds and weaponizes these Permian beasts, deploying them through the Dwarka Gate as cavalry against the native diapsids.
sources: Gondwana: The Asura Intervention and the Fang Wars

title: The Asura Gondwana Intervention
causes: primordial_rift_opens
asura_loka_radiation_spill
outcomes: feathers_evolve_as_thermal_vents
avian_dinosaurids_arise
synapsid_lineages_corrupted
rift_stabilises_as_ganges_lava_sea
summary: An unstabilised rift into Asura Loka floods the Gondwana battlefield with mutagenic energy. The diapsids shed the heat as feathers and become the first avian dinosaurids; some synapsid predators degenerate into the shadow-corrupted lineages the Tendua descends from. The rift hardens into the Ganges Lava Sea.

title: The Battle of Mohenjodaro
causes: A violent altercation in the Harappan marketplace between Sinauli Vedda traders and Naga Northerners
The retaliatory massacre of the Masked Chief's kin on the outskirts of Harappa
outcomes: The military defeat of the Harappan defenders by the Northern Naga clans
The bestowing of the bone mask upon the Harappan champion, establishing the Mask Family lineage
The migration of the new Masked Family from Harappa to the southern deltas
summary: A devastating war between Sinauli traders and Northern Nagas fractures Mohenjodaro. Following the Harappan defeat, the Masked Chief surrenders his bone mask to a valiant champion, whose family adopts the emblem and flees south.

title: Forging of the Dragon’s Spine
outcomes: petrification_of_gorvaxx
formation_of_mountain_pass
summary: Honan battles the deep-time dragon Gorvaxx. The beast is petrified rather than slain, forming the treacherous mountain pass known as the Dragon’s Spine.

title: The Great Devolvement
causes: Severe climate cooling fracturing the ancient deciduous canopy of southern Jambhudweepa
The drying of the Nilgiri canopy forcing the Vanaras onto the open savanna
outcomes: Loss of higher fire-mastery and tool use in the majority of the Vanara populations
Survival of regressed Vanara descendants as modern monkeys and reclusive outliers
The migration of the solar-guided tribes to the central plains under Lionman's pathfinding
summary: As global climate shifts fracture the southern tree-cities of the Nilgiri Canopy, the hyper-intelligent Vanara civilization begins to collapse and devolve. The sun-spirit Lionman manifests to guide the scattered, regressed tribes safely across the savanna.
sources: Ancient Palm-Leaf Manuscripts of Narmada University

title: Shadow Pact of Saraswati
causes: dark_tantra
unicorn_sacrifice
dwarka_gate
outcomes: summoning_of_manjalaya
birth_of_asura_tainted_princess
curse_on_ancient_courts
summary: Prince Varunesh slits an Indus unicorn and uses dark tantra through a Dwarka Gate to summon the Asura princess Manjalaya. Their union produces the immortal Asura-Tainted Princess.

title: The Primordial Union under the Asura Planet
causes: A cataclysmic, world-altering rainfall and rising floodwaters in the Narmada Valley
The ominous orbital approach of a sentient Asura Planet in the sky
outcomes: The union between the primeval Narmada Man and the meditating celestial Apsara
The conquest of the wild lands of beasts and vanaras using her celestial strength
The birth of a shimmering, Asura-tainted egg, which introduced a demonic lineage into Jambhudweepa
The Apsara's ascension to the moon, abandoning the Narmada Man to his mortal grief
summary: During a cataclysmic flood beneath the glow of an approaching Asura planet, the primeval King Narmada Man encounters and unites with a meditating celestial Apsara. Their union grants him the power to conquer the valley but ends in tragedy when she ascends to the moon, leaving behind an Asura-tainted egg.
sources: The Narmada Man: Primordial King of the Riverbones
Narmada Valley: The Primordial Gateway of Jambhudweepa

title: Aravali Massacre & Sanctuary
causes: sira_stolen_mask
dark_manipulation
outcomes: jharwa_village_destroyed
meera_forced_marriage
aravali_sanctuary_established
summary: Sira uses a corrupting mask to manipulate Vedda brothers Ranu and Bela into massacring a Jharwa village. Meera survives and is forced into marriage. Vara-Ma and Orek later help her and hide dangerous masks with Thren in the Aravali sanctuary.

title: The Botai Cattle Raid
causes: botai_raid_on_tushara_herds
outcomes: guyuk_loses_royal_status
guyuk_taken_in_by_nirigili
summary: A Botai raid on the Tushara herds strips Guyuk Mongke of her royal standing and leaves her with nothing. Nirigili Mahashay takes her into his caravan.

title: The Jharwa First-Wave & The Shell Pact
causes: The freezing of the northern steppes during the Pleistocene Glaciation
The rising waters of the Tethys Sea blocking traditional land paths
outcomes: Establishment of the first human settlement in the Saraswati Delta
The creation of the spiritual Shell Pact protecting human sailors
summary: During the Pleistocene Glaciation, the Jharwa cave-painters cross the Tethys Sea to Jambhudweepa. Landing in the Saraswati Delta, Elder Repa establishes the Shell Pact with the Ammonite Man, trading spiral conches for safe passage through the deep channels.

title: Opening of the Naraka Lok Portal
causes: forbidden_tome
possessed_mountain_goat_guidance
guyuk_acquires_tome_with_nirigili_caravan
outcomes: crimson_portal_to_naraka
beast_spill
loss_of_nirigili_mount
guyuk_bloodline_alteration
guyuk_becomes_threshold_bearer
summary: Guyuk, guided by a possessed mountain goat, recites incantations from an ancient tome and tears open a colossal glowing red portal to Naraka Lok. Horrific beasts spill forth; Nirigili loses his Elephantbird to a Megalosaurus.

title: The Narmada Apothecary Herb Quest
causes: Guyuk's request for temporary leave from Nirigili Mahashay's traveling circus caravan
The circus master's condition that she harvest rare, volcanic cliffside herbs for their traveling apothecary
outcomes: Guyuk's peaceful encounter with six ancient Narmada men in a secluded highland village
The successful gathering of rare medicinal flora and her initiation into the primeval bone-lore of the valley
summary: Taking leave from the traveling circus, Guyuk Mongke treks up the volcanic cliffs of the Narmada Valley. Welcomed by six ancient Narmada men, she harvests rare medicinal herbs and learns the primeval lore of the land.
sources: The Narmada Chronicles: Herb 🌿 – Triglav Apothecary

title: The Retreat of Owlman
causes: The aggressive expansion of the Vedda horse-tamers across the Ganges Plain
The clearing of the deep deciduous forests by early charcoal-burners
outcomes: The withdrawal of the three-hundred-and-sixty-degree forest sentinel deeper into the southern Western Ghats
The founding of the hidden tree-temples by Jharwa-Vanara outlier populations to shelter Owlman's quiet spirit
A permanent cultural shift where human-Vanara hybrid descendants became reclusive guardians of the southern canopy
summary: As the horse-taming Vedda clans clear the central forests for pasture, the ancient avian guardian Owlman retreats deep into the Western Ghats. A reclusive group of Jharwa-Vanara outliers construct the first hidden tree-temples to protect his fading presence.
sources: The Stone Scrolls of Dwarka Fortress

title: The Final Voyage of the Kelpfang
causes: The ongoing threat of the Tamra-Veils fracturing reality in the southern Tethys Sea
The urgent mission to retrieve a second Voice-Stone from Lund to form a resonant balancing pair
outcomes: The successful rescue of the Lundish refugees led by Elara Voss
The death of Korran and subsequent dissolution of the Radiant Gentleman to ground the double resonance
The pregnancy of Sirael and Elara, leading to the decision to disband and dismantle the ship
Repurposing the living coral-and-wood hull of the Kelpfang to construct homes in the southern lagoons
summary: The historical chronicle of the living outrigger Kelpfang's final sea voyage. Crewed by the Tamra-Veil Wardens, the ship rescued refugees from the Lundish eruption, weathered a catastrophic stone resonance event, and was eventually dismantled to plant peaceful coastal settlements.
sources: Resonant Hearts: Intimate Chronicles Aboard the Kelpfang

title: The Storm-Bone Khan's Warning at Lothal
causes: guyuk_foresight
tendua_manticore_threat
outcomes: shaashak_forewarned_of_the_beast
mehme_taught_coastal_wind_signals
salt_devourer_carving_left_on_a_boundary_tree
summary: Working the fringes of the Harappan settlement, Guyuk warns Shaashak of the coming Tendua Manticore days before it strikes, teaches Mehme to read the coastal winds at Dwarka, and cuts a warning about the salt devourer into a boundary tree before going.

title: The Wandering of the Narmada Seed-Mind
causes: guyuk_leaves_the_settled_country
walker_between_bones
outcomes: deep_time_songs_taught_to_blind_bards
saplings_traded_for_wild_honey_in_the_aravalis
summary: Guyuk leaves the record. She goes to the Konkan hills carrying the reincarnated seed-mind of the Narmada Man, teaching the deep-time songs to blind bards so the oldest history survives in mouths rather than tablets.
sources: Oral Traditions of the Blind Bards

title: Silvershore War
causes: debt_refusal
silvershore_raid
outcomes: death_of_torin
death_of_jarek
kavik_dominance
summary: Kavik refuses to honor his father’s debt to the Silvershore Dynasty. When they raid Lothal docks, Kavik personally slays Torin and Jarek.

title: Founding of Lothal
causes: migration_from_mohenjo_daro
grief_over_wife_death
outcomes: construction_of_22_story_tower
harappan_dominance_in_delta
summary: Kavik leads Mask Family across Tethys Sea, performs Chandra Grahan ritual, declares himself Raij, and begins construction of the red sandstone tower.

title: Black Lotus Siege
causes: piracy
capture_of_varna
outcomes: rescue_of_varna_and_rathak
kavik_victory
summary: Kavik leads nighttime maritime siege on Black Lotus Fort during thunderstorm. Scales basalt cliffs, battles Naga-Raja, liberates Varna and Rathak.

title: The Stone Pact
causes: need_for_peace_with_kia
outcomes: political_marriage
mask_as_dowry
resentment_of_nila
summary: Political marriage of Shaashak to Khadi sealed under crimson sunset at the base of Kavik's tower. Ancestral Mask of Harappa pledged as dowry.

title: Tendua Crisis and Assassination of Kavik
causes: nila_resentment
asura_mantras_on_tower
outcomes: birth_of_tendua_manticore
death_of_kavik
matriarchal_council
summary: Nila desecrates tower with Asura mantras, birthing Tendua Manticore. During the attack, Asura-possessed Nila assassinates Kavik.

title: Retrieval of the Mask of Harappa
causes: tainted_mask_stolen_by_nila
need_to_repel_tenduas
outcomes: mask_recovered_from_tower_foundation
tenduas_scattered
summary: Asha, iKnaya and Varna recover the bronze raven-and-waves Mask of Harappa from a hidden chamber beneath the tower. Used with other stone masks to drive remaining Tenduas back into the marsh.

title: Exile of Shaashak and Khadi
outcomes: birth_of_sarita
matriarchal_council_asha_iknaya_varna
summary: Grief-stricken Shaashak and Khadi depart upriver on a river skiff to raise their child far from Lothal's tainted legacy. Asha, iKnaya and Varna form ruling council.

title: The Awakening of the Mask of Vaṛkesh
causes: Shaashak's exile from Lothal after her father Kavik's assassination
The relic named in Kavik's stone tablets, which she reads only once he is dead
The placement of the wooden mask onto the central temple altar, triggering the ancient basalt counterweights
outcomes: The awakening of the colossal volcanic stone Golem
The folding of the Sun Plateau's battlefield into a modern tabletop 'Game of Fate'
summary: Shaasak and Asha lead an expedition to a volcanic grotto, uncovering the Mask of Vaṛkesh. The relic awakens a giant stone golem, guiding them to a hidden plateau where the physical world folds into a tabletop game of destiny.
sources: The Mask of Vaṛkesh: The Shore of Forgotten Temples

title: Birth of Sarita Silversong
outcomes: cancer_child_born
symbol_of_harappan_kia_healing
summary: In exile, Shaashak gives birth to Sarita. The child’s first cry echoes her mother’s lullaby. Represents future reconciliation of the two bloodlines.

title: The Antarctic Ice Wall Expedition
causes: The Narmada University mission to chart the southern limits of the Tethys Ocean
Varuna's obsessive drive to find an orderly, logical pathway through the shifting ice of the deep south
outcomes: A deep philosophical standoff between Varuna's drive for active order and the Ammonite Man's preservation of deep-time memory
The discovery of a hidden, bioluminescent sub-glacial current navigated in near-silence with the trawler's engines cut
The preservation of the Antarctic Ice Wall as a sacred, undisturbed geological archive
summary: Bound to mortal bodies, Captain Varuna and his companion Mitra lead a whale-bone trawler into the freezing southern waters of the Tethys. Trapped in a glacial maze, Varuna's drive to ram through the ice wall clashes with the Ammonite Man's drive to preserve it as a memory archive, resolved only when Mitra mediates a silent, drifting passage.
sources: Resonant Hearts: Intimate Chronicles Aboard the Kelpfang

title: The Narmada Upriver Expedition
causes: Dr. Digha Jani's controversial theory on sentient Asura planets and her clash with the skeptical Professor Onko
Recent reports from isolated river villages of a 'false moon' shifting into a demonic Asura face
The Narmada scholars' decision to seek answers upriver toward the mouth of Gondwana where celestial anomalies are not detected
outcomes: Onko and Digha living among isolated river villages while awaiting delayed supplies
Teaching local tribal children to sift and gather precious golden 'spice sand' using cloth and a dish
Mapping of vast natural tea plantations beyond the Shilajit mountain and documenting local cliffside bee-pacts
summary: To investigate sightings of the elusive Asura planet, field historian Digha Jani and the skeptical Professor Onko travel up the Narmada River. Awaiting supplies, they stay with isolated tribes, teaching children to harvest golden spice sand and logging the region's unique cliffside honey-gatherer pacts and tea plantations.
sources: Digha Jani and the Cosmic Secrets of Jambhudweepa
The Predatory Sentience of Asura Planets

title: The Gondwana Spacetime Teleportation
causes: A torrential monsoon downpour trapping the expedition party under the forest canopy of the Narmada Valley
A highly anomalous and energetic lightning strike directly hitting Digha Jani
A succession of blinding lightning strikes fracturing the local fabric of spacetime
outcomes: The sudden physical teleportation of Onko and Digha through a library-like cosmic wormhole filled with floating tomes
Emerging onto the weightless, desolate Gondwana plateau under a skies ruled by a massive, pulsing Asura planet
The discovery of half-buried stone tablets and a massive, oily volcanic black lingam acting as an ancient co-existence boundary stone
summary: During a violent monsoon storm in the Narmada forests, a direct lightning strike leaves Digha Jani unharmed and glowing, before subsequent strikes tear a rift in spacetime. The scholars are teleported through a cosmic wormhole to the floating, weightless Gondwana plateau, where they discover ancient tablets and a basalt boundary stone.
sources: Digha Jani and the Cosmic Secrets of Jambhudweepa
The Predatory Sentience of Asura Planets

title: The Battered Ekranoplan's Ice Wall Voyage
causes: The need for fast travel across the swelling Tethys Sea from the pearl-diving port of Vanga to investigate southern magnetic rifts
Acquiring a cheap, dilapidated ground-effect Soviet-style ekranoplan from local delta salvagers, unaware of a hyperactive Vengi langur stowaway monkey nesting in the cargo hold
outcomes: A highly chaotic, humorous, yet near-fatal transit near the colossal southern Ice Wall sparked by the monkey pulling the emergency fuel shut-off lever
The loss of key equipment overboard during violent, high-speed vibrations and primate panic
summary: At high speeds, a rusted, wobbly ground-effect ekranoplan departs the port of Vanga near the Vengi marshes, carrying a nameless crew and a stowaway langur monkey who causes absolute chaos on their journey to the Antarctic Ice Wall.
sources: We Took a Broken Ekranoplan Across the Tethys Sea - Blog Logs

title: The Solarpunk Odyssey of the Ark
causes: The global flooding and geographic fragmentation of Jambhudweepa following the Great Shattering
The urgent need to gather and protect displaced human survivors across the wild grasslands
outcomes: The successful preservation of human crafting, medical, and agricultural knowledge
The peaceful integration of former rivals (Harappan, Kia, and Steppe Nomads) under a shared survival covenant
The permanent halt and transformation of the Survival Train into the town center of a flourishing solarpunk village
summary: Aboard the colossal greenhouse train, Varuna and Mitra guide human survivors across the wild grasslands of post-cataclysmic Jambhudweepa. Moving through scarcity and storms, they gather refugees and eventually halt the train to construct a permanent, restorative solarpunk community.
sources: The Ark of Epoch 5: A Solarpunk Odyssey
